spots.name: Heikendorf
spots.summary: Heikendorf is a municipality in the district of Plön, in Schleswig-Holstein, Germany. It is a seaside resort off the Baltic Sea, located approximately 10 km from Kiel. The oldest part of the town is the Old Viking settlement in Möltenort.

spots.name: Kiel Castle

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: Kiel Castle in Kiel in the north German state of Schleswig-Holstein was one of the secondary residences of the Gottorf dukes. The castle exhibited a very varied architectural history and in the more recent architectural period became one of the most important secular buildings in Schleswig-Holstein.

spots.name: St. Nikolai, Kiel

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: St. Nikolai is the name of a Protestant parish and its church in Kiel, the capital of Schleswig-Holstein, Germany. It is the town's oldest building, at the Alter Markt. It was dedicated to Saint Nicholas. In the 19th century, it was remodeled in Gothic Revival style.

spots.name: Möltenort U-Boat Memorial
spots.summary: The U-Boot-Ehrenmal Möltenort in Heikendorf near Kiel is a memorial site belonging to the German War Graves Commission, commemorating the sailors who died serving in U-Boat units during the First and Second World Wars, along with all victims of submarine warfare.

spots.name: Kiel Maritime Museum

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: Kiel Maritime Museum is a museum in the German city of Kiel. It was established in 1978 in what had been the fish-auction hall in the Sartorikai area of the city. It shows the maritime history of Kiel.

hours.note: Closed Wed, Sat, Sun

spots.name: Hörn Bridge
spots.summary: The Hörn Bridge is a folding bridge in the city of Kiel in the German state of Schleswig-Holstein. The bridge spans the end of the Kiel Fjord and was designed by Gerkan, Marg and Partners.

spots.name: Zoological Museum of Kiel University

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.summary: The Zoological Museum of Kiel University is a zoological museum in Kiel, Germany. It was founded by naturalist Karl Möbius, and architect Martin Gropius designed the building. The exhibitions display systematics, evolution, tropical and German fauna, butterfly ecology and history of zoology in Kiel.

spots.name: Stadtmuseum Warleberger Hof
spots.summary: Traces of Kiel history: permanent exhibition on the early history of the city and exhibitions on social and cultural history.

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.name: Kunsthalle Kiel

hours.note: Closed Mon, Wed

spots.summary: The Kunsthalle zu Kiel is an art museum in the German city of Kiel. With 2,000 square metres (22,000 sq ft) of display space, it is the largest museum in the city. It is north of the city centre on Düsternbrooker Weg. It has a lecture hall, a small café and a sculpture garden.

spots.name: Kiel Transmission Tower

hours.note: Typical hours — check the official site

spots.summary: The Fernmeldeturm Kiel is a modern landmark of Kiel in Germany, completed in 1975. The 230-metre-high tower, which is used for directional services and TV, VHF and UHF transmission is not accessible to the public. The basket of this tower, which belongs to German Telekom Inc., has a diameter of 40 metres.

hours.note: Closed Mon

spots.name: Levensau High Bridge
spots.summary: The Levensau High Bridge is a high level arch bridge that spans the Kiel Canal in the German state of Schleswig-Holstein. Built in 1894 it is the oldest bridge crossing the Kiel Canal. A second bridge nearby, opened 1984, is referred to as Levensau Motorway Bridge.

spots.name: Opernhaus Kiel
spots.summary: Opernhaus Kiel is the major venue for opera, ballet, and orchestra performances in Kiel, and home to Theater Kiel. It is a Grade II listed building.

spots.name: Kiel Canal
spots.summary: The world's busiest artificial waterway. It is possible to walk or cycle for almost the entire length (98 km) directly along the canal from Kiel to Brunsbüttel (estuary of the Elbe, on the North Sea coast), staying overnight in the town of Rendsburg if necessary.

spots.name: Gorch Fock
spots.summary: Kiel is the home of the German Baltic fleet, and it is common to see various German warships and submarines in the Fjord, including the training sailing vessel Gorch Fock. Checking the port schedule beforehand is recommended for visitors hoping to catch a glimpse of the ship.
